messages:
zoe_support: Escalation from a customer — their analysts report 'No data' on the Usage & Metrics page for the last 30d, but org admins see full charts. Customer org org_6789. Reported two symptoms: (1) dashboard shows empty charts for role=analyst, (2) some API requests from analyst tokens return 200 with empty result set. Filing here to triage.

sre_oncall: Can you paste the exact org_id + an example request/response from the analyst token?

zoe_support: org_id=org_6789. Example curl from customer (redacted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <analyst-token>" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/metrics?org=org_6789&range=30d&role=analyst"
# Response: 200 {"series": [], "note": "no rows"}
```
They tried same request with an admin token and got populated series.

luis_eng: Thanks. Quick theory: RBAC filter or retention tiering is causing the service to point to an empty partition for analyst role. Pinging data team to check ingestion/retention.

data-ingest-bot: alert: org_6789 retention_policy: expired (policy_end=2026-03-01). last_ingest=2026-02-28. Cold-archive cleanup scheduled 2026-03-05.

maya_data: If the retention policy expired, that could remove rows from the hot tables. But that shouldn't selectively affect role=analyst vs admin unless the analytics-service applies role-based view filtering against a separate permissions index. I'll query internal tables now.

luis_eng: I can repro locally: querying metrics table with filter role_label='analyst' returns 0 rows for org_6789, but removing role filter returns rows. Looks like role->dataset mapping broke for analysts.

maya_data: dug in: metrics-service uses service account metrics-reader which needs read access to archived_indices for role mappings. The service account lost the `analytics_reader` role during a permissions prune on 2026-03-01 (coincides with retention job). That caused role lookup to fail and the UI to render empty charts for non-admin roles.

luis_eng: Confirmed in logs: 2026-03-01 03:12:09 WARN role-mapper: failed to fetch role_map for org_6789: permission denied -> 403 from authz-service for principal metrics-reader.

zoe_support: So root cause = retention/permissions sweep removed a role binding on the metrics-service account, causing role-based queries to drop results. Any immediate mitigation? Customer needs data asap.

luis_eng: Short-term mitigation: re-grant analytics_reader to metrics-service for org_6789 and re-run role-map sync. Command (internal):
```
POST /internal/roles/grant
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
Body: {"org":"org_6789","principal":"service:metrics-reader","role":"analytics_reader"}
```
I'll run that now in staging and then prod after smoke tests.

maya_data: Also kicking a restore job for hot rows that might have been archived. Restore queued id: restore-zz12. ETA ~45m for small org. Will update.

tomas_pm: Please confirm ETA for customer-facing message. They asked if this was a billing or API regression.

billing-bot: No billing anomalies detected for org_6789 in the last 90 days.

zoe_support: I'll send an interim note: "We've identified a permissions regression related to a retention sweep that impacted role mappings; engineers are reapplying permissions and restoring hot data. Expect partial visibility restored in ~1h, full charts when restore completes (~45-90m)." Will post update once restore finishes. :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: Deployment plan accepted — will monitor metrics-service errors and dashboard rendering. No expected latency impact.

luis_eng: Applied the role grant in prod at 1761207820, triggered role-map sync. Logs show role-map fetch success at 1761207851. Patching role-mapper to treat missing mappings as FAIL-OPEN for read-only dashboards to avoid total empty state — patch ref abc123, deploy in 10m.

maya_data: Restore job restore-zz12 completed at 1761209220; verified hot table rows present for org_6789. Re-ran customer query with analyst filter -> returned rows.

zoe_support: Customer notified and confirmed they can now see charts as analysts. They were on a call and validated dashboards. Closing ticket once we document follow-ups: (1) add guardrail to retention sweeps to not remove service account bindings, (2) add alert for role-mapper 403 spikes, (3) run a sweep audit for other orgs.

luis_eng: I'll open a follow-up PR for the sweep guardrail and add the alert (ops-1234).

zoe_support: Thanks everyone. Marking resolved for now, will update if customer sees regressions. :white_check_mark:
